queries_run: CVS Health Aetna market share gaining OR losing 2026
CVS Caremark PBM market share new entrant displace threat 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 稱健康福利業新進入者與產業整併加劇競爭，新興對手含新創health plan、醫院自有health plan、合資、金融／顧問公司私有交易所及零售業等非傳統通路
findings.excerpt: New entrants into the marketplace, as well as consolidation within the industry, have contributed to and are expected to intensify the competitive environment.

findings.claim: 10-K 列示PBM主要對手：Prime Therapeutics、MedImpact、Express Scripts(Cigna)、Optum Rx(UnitedHealth)及獨立PBM；零售藥局對手含Walgreens、Walmart、Amazon
findings.excerpt: The Health Services segment has a significant number of competitors offering PBM services, including large, national PBM companies (e.g., Prime Therapeutics and MedImpact), PBMs owned by large national health plans (e.g., the Express Scripts business of Cigna Corporation and the Optum Rx business of UnitedHealth Group) and smaller standalone PBMs.
